text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Are you living your best youth right now!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daitaku Helios—
meeting her was an absolute shock.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Whew, looking good, looking good~☆
Hype-mode Trainer-pi is on point☆
Team Tre-Gaku, let's smash it!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A noisy party girl who casually sticks her nose into anything that looks fun. But once she starts running—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Is there anything better than this!?
I just love racing!
Super crazy mega-love it~~☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bright and dazzling, enjoying every single race from the bottom of her heart.
Her sun-like running style... No, her vibes, captivated me—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Seriously looking forward to working with you, Trainer☆
Oh, do you need my seal? Are edited photos okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's been decided that we'll race through the Twinkle Series
together... or rather, turn it into a festival—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"I totally can't take it anymore either!!
I can't do festivals~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Pien!!
And now WAAAAHH! Boo-hoo-hoo~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I mean, come on!!
The Young Lady is, like, waaahhh!!
choice_data_list: The young lady... you mean Daiichi Ruby, right?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I love it! I'm in love!
Toootally my type!!
Please be my favorite person ever!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby. She's a young lady from a prestigious family
known as the "Illustrious Lineage,"
and apparently Daitaku Helios's "crush"...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ye~~p!! An' listen, I just talked to Ruby a second ago!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Super Dumped!!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"—I apologize,
but I must decline your lunch invitation."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Eeeeehh!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Why not?! Let's eat the MAX Mega-Mount Chomolan-Burger! It's so hilariously delicious, I swear!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"Since I have a set daily meal plan,
I'm afraid I cannot accept spontaneous invitations."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Huh?!!
Does that mean I can eat meals with you for the rest of my life, ojousama?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I'm feeling the moment!
Going with the vibe right here, right now!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Ojou, why not get into the groove sometimes??
It's fun☆ I mean, I'll make sure you have a blast!"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Have fun... is it?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Right?! Are you feeling hyped yet?!?!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"No, what you just said made it even clearer.
I doubt there will be many opportunities
for us to sit together in the future."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
—You and I have
completely different ways of seeing the world.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Talking about "the world" makes literally no sense, y'know?
I mean, we're all on the same Earth, right?! Like, seriously!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, no way!
I gotta go get some fresh air for a sec!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I'll be right back!
Wait for me~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Trusting their word that they would be right back, I decided to wait for now.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
—Waaaahhh!!
I'm so, like, totally bawling my eyes out right now~~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ojo is being so salty~! It's too much~!
I'm so seriously depressed right nowww~!!
Umm...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You okay? 
I don't really get it, but if something's bothering you, wanna talk about it?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: —Totally!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, that's definitely bittersweet!
Though... Ruby, huh.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"What's with that reaction!?
What do you mean!?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ruby's family, like, feels like real-deal royalty, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
From business and politics to the world of racing—everywhere
her clan has left their mark.
Sort of like... beings above the clouds, huh?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Isn't that basically the same world?
Like, if you take a plane, you can go above the clouds, right?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Nah, sorry.
I was just speaking metaphorically—"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, so it's about height~ Gotcha!
Alrighty, I'll go get some jump practice in!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...Are you being serious?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: I'm always dead serious!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Phew, that was super refreshing!
Thanks a bunch, um...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...It's Palmer.
*Mejiro*... Palmer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: "...Even though you say that! I'm really not the refined Mejiro ojou-sama type at all, I'm just a super ordinary horse girl, so—"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Okey-doke, thanks a mil, Palmer-chin! Tysm!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
!
Is that all...?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
?
Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Btw, let's sing~☆ What's your vibe, Palmer-chin?
Should we just blast the school anthem for now?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
A school song?!
We have one?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Well, you see...
There actually is one!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"No way~!?
How did you even think to look for it!?"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
We were just joking around like, 'Let's find
a song that doesn't exist,' and my bestie found it!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Btw, this is the song I found!
"Super Hype Energy Drink Bomb Udon 210 Yen"!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: What's that supposed to mean?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
—Phew~~!
That was so much fun!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Palmer-chin, your vibes are unreal!
You even nailed finding that unreleased track! That's my BFF!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: What does 'besties for life' mean?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Friends forever!
Besties for the resties, you know? Like BFFs~☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Best friends?!
Wait, didn't we just meet for the first time today?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't matter♪
If that's what I think, then that's what it is! That's the right answer☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha.
I see!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Mm, thanks!
I had fun too... um.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: B... Besties forever!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I'll be right back"—
How many hours had passed since she said those words?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
—An' so, Jordan got so pissed!
I tagged her in a bunch of stuff, so her notifications were blowing up like crazy!
And the hilarious thing is—...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ah! Trai-pi, good work~☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Lemme introduce ya! This is my bestie Palmie, and this is
my Trainy-pi☆ Nice to meetcha~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Hey there... Wait, Trainer, don't you look kind of tired?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
For real?!
That's hilarious~☆
choice_data_list: ...By the way, are you done crying now?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
No way I can stay bummed out☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I've got more besties now too!
Let's roll in with our hype cranked to the max~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: —To the Twinkle Fest!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Totally~☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer, isn't that hilarious?
Her comebacks are so fast! Totally god-tier☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, I pretty much get the gist of everything.
Do your best, Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so began our training days with Daitaku Helios—destined to be full of chaotic fun.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Hm? What's up?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Totes!
For now, just blow 'em away! Woohoo☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And so began the noisy days of training with Daitaku Helios!
